description: Ten D030 landscape candidates pinned to exact native versions and checksums for unapproved reference comparison; v011 binds the selected versions to final plan SHA-256 f97a4929922abdade7f674281f7f84a91575edfdaf40b19fbed449afcf2f0a0f.
review_notice: Unapproved landscape candidates for comparison only. Candidate images are not art approval and do not update art/approved/. Final plan SHA-256: f97a4929922abdade7f674281f7f84a91575edfdaf40b19fbed449afcf2f0a0f. Independent review j passed S001–S008 at their exact checksums. The two authorized skin-only edit attempts did not bring selected Bali skin below the new S009 <100 red-minus-blue target or S010's existing <100 target. S009 v007 is the best measured choice among v007/v008/v009, with chest/shoulder and arm patches R−B 135 and 134; S010 v005 is the best among v005/v006/v007, with face and arm patches R−B 127 and 78. Both remain producer needs-fix and those deviations are disclosed. One fresh independent exact-checksum review of all ten against this final plan is pending. Photos 005 and 006 both map to stanza 5; photo 005 depicts the birth rather than stanza 5. Photo 007 depicts Bali's later foot-washing scene rather than stanza 6; photo 009 mismatches stanza 8. Stanza 10 has no supplied photo or caption; its scene derives from canonical text alone. Portrait production is paused. No candidate is approved.
visual_review_status: Independent review j passed S001–S008 and found S009/S010 needs-fix for Bali's orange skin. The producer preserved all two skin-only edit attempts in both stanzas and selected the lowest measured deviations: S009 v007 (R−B 135/134; needs-fix) and S010 v005 (R−B 127 face, 78 arm; needs-fix). The remaining threshold deviations are disclosed with exact patch medians. Fresh independent exact-checksum review of all ten against final plan f97a4929922abdade7f674281f7f84a91575edfdaf40b19fbed449afcf2f0a0f is pending. No art approval.

rows.scene: Bali is restored by Shukra’s rite and rules with power; distant Devas withdraw in fear. Keep the prior battle implied, not graphic.
rows.candidate_status: Producer uncertain: the native and enlarged views show Bali’s two feet with five distinct toes each. Representative 15×15 skin-only patch medians are Bali R−B 118, Shukra R−B 107, and three Deva upper-arm patches R−B 118, 119 and 121; the last is narrowly above the plan’s below-120 guide. A withdrawing Deva’s foreshortened raised hand does not expose a countable thumb. No malformed or extra digit is visible, but the hand and marginal skin result remain uncertain.

rows.scene: Aditi grieves for her sons and seeks Kashyapa’s help; he instructs the twelve-day milk vow and worship.
rows.candidate_status: Producer pass: Aditi and Kashyapa are distinct and naturally posed at the riverside hermitage. Enlarged views show coherent prayer hands and Kashyapa’s one-index teaching gesture; no malformed or extra digit is visible. Representative 15×15 face-patch medians are Aditi R−B 115 and Kashyapa R−B 82; both read as brown.

rows.scene: After the vow, the dark blue four-armed Lord appears before Aditi and tells her he will be born as her son. Exactly four attached arms.
rows.candidate_status: Producer pass: Vishnu has exactly four attached arms, three distinct attributes and a clear blessing palm with thumb plus four fingers; both feet show five toes. Vishnu skin-only samples measure B−R 61; Aditi cheek/forearm patches measure R−B 86/95 and read muted brown. Final-plan independent review is pending.

rows.scene: Show the auspicious birth to Aditi on Dvadashi and Shravana; the child is the manifest divine form. Keep the moment intimate.
rows.candidate_status: Producer uncertain: the infant has one face, four attached arms with four attributes, and two five-toed feet; its one simple short neck strand remains. Sampled Aditi cheek/forearm R−B 100/108, Kashyapa cheek/forearm 108/118, and infant face/torso B−R 94/98 meet final-plan limits. Aditi's supporting hand is partly overlapped by the infant's legs, so the producer cannot count every digit confidently; no malformed or fused digit is evident. Independent exact-checksum review pending.

rows.scene: Exactly two individually distinct Devas in modest plain matte crowns shower flowers while Aditi and Kashyapa praise with joined hands; one young two-armed Vamana stands with parasol and staff.

reference.label: Original reference: photo 006 (both 005 and 006 map to #5)

rows.candidate_status: Producer pass: S005 v019 corrects the two Devas' excessive regalia. The younger clean-shaven Deva has a low rounded plain matte ochre crown; the older gray-bearded Deva has a simple taller plain matte ochre crown. Layered neck/chest ornaments are removed; their faces, dress, poses and identities remain distinct. The scene retains Aditi and Kashyapa praying, exactly two flower-showering Devas, one two-armed Vamana with parasol/staff, the empty cradle, folded indigo cloth and four separate tokens; enlarged views show five toes on each visible foot and coherent visible hands. Measured 15×15 skin patches: Aditi R−B 110; Kashyapa 114; younger Deva 112; older Deva 55; these are below final plan limit 120 and read brown. Vamana face/torso B−R 49/48 meets plan minimum 45 and reads deep indigo. These measurements do not meet the earlier v018 prompt's more ambitious parent/Deva/Vamana palette goals (75/100/60); no palette edit was authorized in this ornament-only round, and this deviation is disclosed.

rows.scene: Prajapatis perform Vamana’s initiation and offer sacred thread, staff, deer skin and prayer beads; after the fire rite he departs toward Bali’s Ashvamedha.
rows.candidate_status: Producer pass: Brahma has four heads total, three front-visible faces, and four attached arms/hands with attributes. Three visible crowns are matching low matte ochre forms without tiers, gems or medallions; one fine bead strand accompanies the sacred thread. The front headband has one small flat central ochre dot. Human elder skin-only patches R−B 88 and 97 meet the below-100 plan target; Vamana face/torso B−R 131/129 are deep indigo. Independent exact-checksum review pending.

rows.scene: The short brahmachari walks with umbrella and staff; the earth subtly trembles under his emerging divine gravity. Two arms, no Krishna feather or crown.
rows.candidate_status: Producer pass: one youthful Vamana walks alone with umbrella and staff over lightly cracked ground; no extra people, Krishna-only forehead mark, feather or crown. Both feet are fully in frame with five distinct toes each. Face/torso skin-only patch medians measure B−R 51/47 and read deep muted indigo, meeting the plan minimum 45.

rows.scene: Vamana arrives at the Hayamedha hall on the north bank of the Narmada. His presence dazzles Shukra and sages, who wonder whether he is Sun, Fire, Sanatkumara or a yogi.

reference.label: Original reference (caption/photo mismatch; canonical scene controls)

rows.candidate_status: Producer pass: Shukra and three sages are visibly distinct; no repeated sage. Human skin patches range R-B 90–108; Vamana cheek B-R 99. Both Vamana feet show five toes. Prior independent review passed this exact checksum against the earlier plan. Final-plan independent review is pending.

rows.scene: Bhrigus bring radiant Vamana to Bali’s hall. Bali welcomes him, washes both feet and receives that water reverently on his head.
rows.candidate_status: Producer needs-fix: v007 is the lowest-deviation choice after two authorized skin-only edit attempts (v008/v009). Skin-only 32×32 chest/shoulder patch at x=990,y=505 has median RGB (178,103,43), R−B 135; 24×24 bent-arm patch at x=890,y=545 is RGB (162,90,28), R−B 134. Both exceed the final-plan <100 target and still read orange/copper by the measured criterion. Water visibly reaches Bali's cupped hand and bowed crown; the hand shows five digits and Vamana's feet show five toes. Independent fresh exact-checksum review pending.

rows.scene: Canonical-only stanza 10: two-armed Vamana raises his foot; the continuous sacred water touches Bali’s bowed head and flows onward to Shiva’s matted hair. No photo or caption is mapped.
rows.candidate_status: Producer needs-fix: v005 is the lowest-deviation choice after two authorized skin-only edit attempts (v006/v007). Skin-only face patch at x=678,y=457, 12×12, median RGB (174,109,47), R−B 127, exceeds the final-plan <100 target; upper-arm patch at x=825,y=565, 24×24, RGB (146,99,68), R−B 78, meets it. The face remains orange/copper by the measured criterion. Vamana retains two attached arms and five toes on both visible feet; the water reaches Bali's bowed head and continues to Shiva. Independent fresh exact-checksum review pending.
